require 'json'

=begin
Block comment
=end
module Demo
  VERSION = "1.0"

  class Greeter
    attr_accessor :name
    @@count = 0

    def initialize(name = "world")
      @name = name
      @@count += 1
      $last = self
    end

    def greet(times: 1)
      text = "Hello, #{@name}! Count: #{@@count}\n"
      words = %w[alpha beta gamma]
      syms = %i(one two)
      pattern = /\d+ "quoted"/i
      doc = <<~EOS
        Heredoc with #{name}
          indented
      EOS
      ratio = 10 % 3
      opts = { key: :value, other: nil }
      return text * times if times.positive?
      puts doc, words, syms, pattern, ratio, opts, 0x1F, 1_000, 3.14, defined?(x)
    end
  end
end

Demo::Greeter.new.greet(times: 2) unless false
